remediation.failure_reason: V1 applied a relative terminal-current imbalance gate to nine external-VDS=0 output points whose absolute currents were at numerical-noise scale; the separate frozen zero-VDS absolute-current gate already passed.
remediation.v2_change: Apply the unchanged relative terminal-current imbalance threshold only where external VDS>0; apply the unchanged absolute-current threshold only where external VDS=0.

scope.device: 2D n-IGZO electron-only drift-diffusion teaching model with the T02-A enabled symmetric dual-gate stack
scope.purpose: Freeze a formal isolated source-drain series-resistance sensitivity that distinguishes a self-consistent lumped contact proxy from the unchanged channel model.
fixed_variables: channel length = 10 um and width = 60 um
top and bottom physical Al2O3 thickness = 30 nm
top and bottom dielectric relative permittivity = 6.8
interface_4x mesh with fixed 0.25 um x spacing
top gate is primary and bottom gate is fixed at 0 V
bulk NTA, NGA, NTD and NGD = 0
source and drain use equal one-half shares of the declared total pair resistance
no barrier-height variation, thermionic emission, tunneling, recombination, ferroelectric polarization, or temperature variation
prohibited_work_before_contract_pass: simultaneous trap, mobility, geometry, dielectric, temperature, or contact-asymmetry scan
P5, M00, M01, SPICE, circuit-cell, layout, PEX, or HZO work
prohibited_claims_after_future_run: measured, extracted, fitted, or calibrated contact resistance for the project device
Schottky barrier, thermionic injection, tunneling, current crowding, or metal-work-function validation
physical Ion, mobility, VTH, SS, process distribution, or uncertainty
complete T03, compact-model, SPICE, circuit, layout, PEX, or HZO evidence

literature_mapping.project_mapping: The two reported numerical magnitudes are used only as lower and upper values of the project-defined total source-plus-drain R_pair*W teaching proxy.
literature_mapping.reason: The paper device, stack, process, overdrive and contact-extraction convention differ from this project; an explicit total-pair convention avoids silently treating the external values as project contact parameters.

cases.source_role: E1 lower numerical magnitude mapped to the project total-pair proxy
E1 upper numerical magnitude mapped to the project total-pair proxy

sensitivity.interpretation: Three-point controlled numerical sensitivity only; values are neither a project TLM extraction nor metal-specific project parameters.

contact_model_contract.spatial_representation: The IGZO device remains 2D; each nonzero contact resistance is an external lumped resistor and is not spatially resolved in the contact region.
contact_model_contract.zero_control_rule: R_pair*W=0 uses the unchanged direct ideal-ohmic T02 contact equations; no zero-valued circuit resistor is created.
contact_model_contract.nonzero_rule: Each device source and drain contact is coupled to an internal circuit node, a resistor connects each internal node to its external voltage-source node, and the device plus circuit equations are solved together.
required_devsim_api: circuit_element with V and R elements
stored_circuit_quantities: internal source and drain node voltage
device source and drain terminal current
source, drain and total resistor voltage drop

inheritance.transfer_bias_source: config/tcad_t02_c_bidirectional.json top_primary at fixed secondary gate = 0 V
inheritance.output_bias_source: config/tcad_t01_d_idvd.json with additional 0.001 V and 0.005 V low-field points
inheritance.reason_traps_are_zero: P3 attribution changes only the declared contact proxy; completed P2 evidence is not combined into this isolated scan.

execution_order: for each R_pair*W value create one fresh transfer device
solve all-zero-bias Poisson initialization and coupled electron equilibrium
continue the external drain through 0.001, 0.005 and 0.01 V
precondition the top gate from 0 V down to -0.5 V
record the exact 31-point top-gate transfer grid with bottom gate at 0 V
for each of the three output top-gate values create a separate fresh device
solve zero-bias Poisson and coupled equilibrium, ramp the top gate at zero external VDS, then record all seven external VDS points
save the VTG=1.0 V, external VDS=0.2 V state and circuit quantities for each R_pair*W value
delete every device and its circuit before the next case

transfer_high_gate_current_proxy.bias: VTG=1.0 V, VBG=0 V, external VDS=0.01 V
transfer_high_gate_current_proxy.definition: absolute external drain current and current per device width
transfer_high_gate_current_proxy.label: sampled low-VDS high-gate current numerical proxy; not physical Ion

output_current_proxies.biases: VTG=0.3, 0.5 and 1.0 V; VBG=0 V; external VDS=0.2 V
output_current_proxies.definition: absolute external drain current and current per device width
output_current_proxies.label: sampled output-current numerical proxies; not physical Ion or saturation current

linear_region_total_resistance_width_pro.fit: ordinary least squares of absolute external drain current versus external VDS constrained through the origin
linear_region_total_resistance_width_pro.label: external linear-region total-resistance-width numerical proxy; includes channel plus configured lumped pair

extracted_added_resistance_matches_decla.comparison: Delta_R_totalW versus declared R_pair*W for each nonzero case
extracted_added_resistance_matches_decla.reason_non_gating: The OLS total-resistance proxy also contains transistor nonlinearity and source-degeneration effects; exact resistor behavior is gated directly through KCL, Ohm-law and voltage-partition closure.

state_output_contract.bias: VTG=1.0 V, VBG=0 V, external VDS=0.2 V

electron_current_density.source_model: DEVSIM ElectronCurrent edge model projected by element_from_edge_model

acceptance.circuit_closure_gate_domain: nonzero R_pair*W, external VDS>0, and VTG>=0.3 V

failure_retention.on_exception_or_failed_gate: write an E0 FAIL report, preserve every completed solver record and partial artifact, and stop before the independent checker

evidence_boundary.contract_allowed_claim: The P3 V2 input contract preserves the complete V1 E0/FAIL evidence and freezes an E1-anchored, three-point, symmetric lumped total-pair series-resistance proxy, self-consistent device-circuit coupling, biases, extraction, failure retention, outputs and unchanged numerical thresholds while separating the nonzero-VDS relative-current gate from the zero-VDS absolute-current gate, without running DEVSIM.
evidence_boundary.future_run_allowed_claim: Only runner E2 plus independent persisted-evidence E3 PASS may establish a controlled contact-series-resistance numerical sensitivity for the frozen 2D teaching model.
allowed_parameter_labels: symmetric lumped total-pair resistance-width teaching proxy
sampled low-VDS high-gate current numerical proxy
prohibited_claims: measured, TLM-extracted, fitted, or calibrated project-device contact resistance
project Ti-versus-Ni contact comparison or contact-metal selection
Schottky barrier, thermionic injection, tunneling, current crowding, or work-function validation
physical Ion, mobility, VTH, SS, process variation, uncertainty, or experimental accuracy
complete P3 before runner and independent check PASS
complete T03, P5, compact-model, SPICE, circuit-cell, layout, PEX, or HZO evidence
evidence_boundary.v1_failure_boundary: V1 remains E0/FAIL despite completing 12 devices, 243 converged DC solves and 156 points; V2 does not reinterpret V1 as PASS and does not run the V1 independent checker.
evidence_boundary.next_gate: V2 contract PASS permits only one formal P3 V2 contact-resistance runner; runner PASS is required before the independent persisted-evidence checker, and both are required to complete P3.
